Do not add an upper hump, protruding shelf, stepped notch, decorative crest, second arc, raised hood, solid control pedestal, enclosing panel or extra table outline. 1. Move the generic hand-count medallion from its current high location down by about 90px into the INSIDE LEFT SHOULDER of the hand table. Center roughly x=430,y=765 on the target image. Keep diameter approx 76px. It must float nowhere: its back is inset flush into the dark table surface BELOW the arc, in the clear gap between the leftmost card and the left book prop. It touches neither card nor book. Label "手牌" above "5 / 4", with 5 rust red and /4 ivory. Its position belongs to the generic hand UI and never depends on the themed relief. Remove the old medallion location entirely.

2. RECOMPOSE THE PROMPT AND BUTTONS HORIZONTALLY ON THE EXISTING FLAT TABLETOP ABOVE THE CARDS, AS ONE LOW GROUP. Remove the current instruction ribbon and button vertical stack. The new single horizontal group occupies roughly x=350–1000,y=565–619. The instruction is on the LEFT, the action button is immediately to its RIGHT, aligned vertically at their centers, no separate row floating above. Primary text "请弃置 1 张手牌", and smaller second line "已选 0 / 1" directly beneath it, are set into the SAME understated matte dark teal ground as the adjacent button. Place the existing "确认弃牌" button to the right of that text, with the original restrained bronze frame. Close 12–16px gap, common baseline, clear hierarchy.
Ground the WHOLE group using ONLY a soft local darkening of the EXISTING background, a subtle smooth-stone texture on the same plane, and very short contact shadows under the button lower bevel. The text backing and button backing must flow into one another with no empty scenery gap. This shared ground has NO outer border or distinct edge: all sides feather smoothly into the environment. It is a flush surface treatment, not a shape-changing pedestal. No floating ribbon, no long ornamental underline, no plaque around the instruction, no brackets around the whole group. Keep the group visually close to the cards but leave sufficient clear space for card hover rise by 22px. Do not intersect the curved rail with this control group.

Preserve every other element exactly: all FIVE large portrait cards, their 392:590 physical shape, original size and actual artwork, fixed 20% overlap and current fan positions; all upper player panels, HP/SAN, piles, log and soft fading panel bottoms; both existing replaceable relief images. No new actions, no extra symbols on cards, no cost circles. Do not change card shape, width or height to make space for controls.
Style: restrained high-fidelity dark Cthulhu game UI, old bronze and deep teal, clear warm ivory typography, visual unity through spacing and local shadows. Keep the dark continuous scenery between upper and lower game areas, avoid large graphic divisions. One full landscape screen, no labels/annotations/comparison sheet.
